title: DecisionRobust: Benchmarking Robustness for JEV Style Decision Models Across Text and Vision
abstract: arXiv:2610.19118v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emerging decision models such as JEV provide typed interfaces that map task instructions and observations directly to choices, judgments, and scores. As these models are increasingly used for automated decision-making, understanding their reliability under adversarial manipulation becomes critical. We introduce DecisionRobust, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the robustness of decision models across textual and visual inputs. Our benchmark covers practical decision-making scenarios and a diverse suite of attacks, including semantics-preserving text perturbations, image perturbations, and prompt injection in both modalities. We curate evaluation sets through external validity checks and cross-model candidate selection. We evaluate 30 model configurations on text tasks and 17 on vision tasks, including 24 and 12 held-out models, respectively, that are excluded from candidate selection. Our experiments reveal several key findings.

translated_title: DecisionRobust：面向文本与视觉的JEV风格决策模型鲁棒性基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.19118v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：诸如JEV等新兴决策模型提供了类型化的接口，能够将任务指令和观察结果直接映射到选择、判断和评分。随着这些模型越来越多地被用于自动化决策，理解它们在对抗性操纵下的可靠性变得至关重要。我们提出了DecisionRobust，这是一个用于系统性评估决策模型在文本和视觉输入下鲁棒性的基准。该基准涵盖实际的决策场景以及多样化的攻击套件，包括保持语义的文本扰动、图像扰动以及两种模态下的提示注入。我们通过外部有效性检查和跨模型候选选择来构建评估集。我们在文本任务上评估了30个模型配置，在视觉任务上评估了17个模型配置，其中包括分别从候选选择中排除的24个和12个留出模型。我们的实验揭示了若干关键发现。
tldr: 本文提出DecisionRobust基准，通过涵盖语义保持文本扰动、图像扰动和提示注入等多种攻击方式，系统性评估了JEV风格决策模型在文本与视觉输入下面对对抗性操纵的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DecisionRobust, a benchmark that systematically evaluates the robustness of JEV-style decision models against adversarial manipulation across text and vision inputs, covering semantics-preserving text perturbations, image perturbations, and prompt injection attacks.
